questions.q: The most consistent biochemical finding in nutritional rickets is:
questions.why: Alkaline phosphatase rises with osteoblastic activity; phosphate is low and PTH high.

questions.q: The Drugs and Cosmetics Rules require homoeopathic medicines to be manufactured under a licence issued by:
questions.why: Topic 3, Pharmacy. Licences are issued by the State Drug Controller (State Licensing Authority).

questions.q: In a prescription, the symbol Rx forms the:
questions.why: The superscription is Rx (recipe, take). The inscription names the medicine, the subscription instructs the dispenser and the signatura instructs the patient.

questions.q: In Kent's Repertory, the rubric for constipation is in the chapter:
questions.why: Constipation and diarrhoea are rubrics of Rectum; Stool describes the character of the stool itself.

questions.q: According to §108, the peculiar effects of medicines on human health can be ascertained only by:
opts: giving them experimentally in moderate doses to healthy persons
observing their effects in the sick
chemical analysis of the drug substance
questions.why: §108: there is no other way than to administer medicines experimentally to healthy persons.

questions.q: Horrock's apparatus is used to find:
opts: the dose of bleaching powder needed to disinfect well water
questions.why: Horrock's apparatus estimates the amount of bleaching powder needed to give a free residual chlorine in water.

questions.q: In Kent's Repertory, symptoms of the nails are found in the chapter:
